FSTORE-1001.name: FortiGate Secure Branch Bundle
FSTORE-1001.headline: High-performance firewall, SD-WAN, and threat protection for branch and campus networks.
FSTORE-1001.positioning: Use FortiGate when the customer needs a security-first network edge with firewalling, VPN, segmentation, application control, and unified management hooks in one appliance family.
FSTORE-1001.best_for: Branch offices, distributed enterprises, and mid-market teams that want consolidated routing and security at the edge.
key_points: Consolidates next-generation firewall, secure SD-WAN, IPS, VPN, and application visibility.
Pairs naturally with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized operations.
Good anchor product when the buyer asks for perimeter, branch, or segmentation guidance.

FSTORE-1002.name: FortiSASE Remote Workforce Package
FSTORE-1002.headline: Cloud-delivered secure access for remote users, SaaS applications, and internet-bound traffic.
FSTORE-1002.positioning: Use FortiSASE when users are everywhere and the customer wants consistent security inspection without forcing every session through a physical branch.
FSTORE-1002.best_for: Hybrid workforces, contractor access, and organizations modernizing from VPN-only remote access.
key_points: Combines secure web gateway, zero-trust access, cloud access security controls, and centralized policy.
Complements FortiGate for customers that want the same security intent at branches and for roaming users.
Good answer when the buyer asks about remote employees, ZTNA, SaaS, or reducing VPN dependence.

FSTORE-1003.name: FortiClient Endpoint Protection
FSTORE-1003.headline: Endpoint visibility, posture, VPN/ZTNA client access, and response controls.
FSTORE-1003.positioning: Use FortiClient when endpoint posture and secure user access need to feed network and cloud access decisions.
FSTORE-1003.best_for: Security teams that need endpoint compliance, remote-access enforcement, and tighter user-device context.
key_points: Helps connect device posture to access decisions.
Works well with FortiGate and FortiSASE stories where identity and endpoint state matter.
Useful for demos that need a user/device security conversation instead of only network-edge controls.

FSTORE-1004.name: FortiWeb Application Security
FSTORE-1004.headline: Web application and API protection for public-facing apps, portals, and AI-adjacent services.
FSTORE-1004.positioning: Use FortiWeb when the customer needs layer-7 application protection, API security, bot controls, and inspection in front of web workloads.
FSTORE-1004.best_for: Teams exposing web applications, APIs, partner portals, and application gateways.
key_points: Protects application-layer traffic that a network firewall alone may not understand deeply.
Pairs with FortiGate at the network edge and FortiAnalyzer for operational visibility.
Good fit when buyers mention OWASP, API risk, bot traffic, or application-layer attacks.

FSTORE-1005.name: FortiCNAPP Cloud Security Starter
FSTORE-1005.headline: Cloud posture, workload, and risk visibility for teams moving quickly in public cloud.
FSTORE-1005.positioning: Use FortiCNAPP when cloud teams need unified visibility across configuration risk, workload posture, and application security signals.
FSTORE-1005.best_for: Cloud platform teams, DevSecOps teams, and enterprises building multi-cloud guardrails.
key_points: Frames cloud security around posture, workload, and runtime risk instead of only perimeter controls.
Useful when the buyer asks about AWS, Azure, containers, pipelines, or cloud-native security.
Complements FortiGate and FortiWeb where cloud apps also need network and application protection.

FSTORE-1006.name: FortiAnalyzer Operations Visibility
FSTORE-1006.headline: Centralized logging, reporting, analytics, and investigation workflows for Fortinet environments.
FSTORE-1006.positioning: Use FortiAnalyzer when the customer needs to turn Fortinet security events into operational evidence, dashboards, reports, and investigations.
FSTORE-1006.best_for: SOC teams, compliance teams, managed service providers, and operators responsible for distributed Fortinet deployments.
key_points: Centralizes event visibility across Fortinet controls.
Supports reporting and investigation workflows for security and operations teams.
Good recommendation whenever the buyer asks how to prove value, monitor outcomes, or track policy impact.
